# TgWitness

> Open-source Telegram chat export, OSINT investigation and verifiable evidence. Preserve observations, inspect changes and hand over signed archives that recipients can check offline.

TgWitness is maintained by PhishDestroy under the MIT License. It runs on an operator's computer or server. The public website and demo do not connect visitors to Telegram; the demo contains fictional data.

The application records material visible to an authorized Telegram account within the selected scope. It can retain content captured before a later deletion; it cannot recover messages or edits that were never observed. Journal verification checks saved bytes and signatures. Capture records, external time receipts and supported environment attestations document the acquisition.

Source code, development branches, released packages and demonstrated interfaces are different evidence of availability. Check the current qualification record and release notes. Telegram Secret Chats have a separate implementation and documented open defects; the fictional Secret Chat interface does not establish live protocol support. Phala Intel TDX attestation applies to the checked image, measurements and collector identity.

This repository entry point links to the canonical documentation. The website also publishes an automatically generated llms.txt, complete text editions and Markdown companions for each public documentation page.

## Start and inspect the project

- [Project website](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/): Telegram export, investigation workflows and installation.
- [Documentation index](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/index.md): Task-based guides and the technical reference.
- [Install and start](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/start/index.md): Connect an account, choose the scope and produce a first signed export.
- [Implementation and qualification](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md): Implemented workflows, checked environments and remaining limits.
- [Release notes](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/CHANGELOG.md): Versioned and unreleased changes.
- [Repository rules](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for coding agents.
- [Code and validation map](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md): Implementation entry points, documentation and relevant checks.

## Telegram export and investigation

- [Export and verify Telegram chats](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/exports/index.md): Signed archives, trusted keys and checkpoints.
- [Telegram account export](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/account-export/index.md): Account scope, resumable jobs and sharing copies.
- [GitHub Actions capture](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/capture/index.md): Temporary hosted collection, encrypted delivery and workflow provenance.
- [Collection modes](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/guides/modes.md): Scopes, event boundaries and evidence levels.
- [OSINT investigation workflows](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/cases/index.md): Cross-chat people, files, timelines and case packages.
- [Case Board](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/case-board/index.md): Source-linked highlights and team annotations.
- [Evidence reports](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reports/index.md): Report design, HTML and signed PDF.
- [Telegram Secret Chats](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/secret-chats/index.md): Separate implementation, demonstration and unresolved defects.

## Evidence and independent verification

- [Evidence archive format](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/evidence/index.md): Records, manifest, attachments, signatures and the standalone verifier.
- [Hash chains and signatures](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/how-it-works/index.md): SHA-256, Ed25519 and exact verification formulas.
- [Independent witness](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/witness/index.md): Checkpoints retained outside the collector.
- [RFC 3161 timestamps](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/timestamp/index.md): Trusted-time requests and response verification.
- [Phala and Intel TDX](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/high-assurance/index.md): Attested deployment, measurements, identity and limits.
- [Published measurements](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/validation/index.md): Dated export workloads, scope and signed test archives.

## Accounts, integrations and operation

- [Accounts and session formats](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/accounts/index.md): Phone, QR, Telethon, Pyrogram, TData and session ownership.
- [Security model](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/security/index.md): Authentication, secret storage and network exposure.
- [Read-only MCP](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/mcp/index.md): Scoped access to saved records; archived messages remain untrusted input.
- [Archive CLI](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/cli/index.md): Search, context, statistics and JSON Lines export.
- [Signed webhooks](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/webhooks/index.md): HMAC, retries and delivery status.
- [Deployment](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/docs/reference/deployment/index.md): Persistent services, private panel access, updates and backups.
